bullets.text: Highlight Reels for Xbox - Xbox Insiders can now test highlight reels in the Xbox PC app for ROG Xbox Ally X.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New Canary Channel build introduces voice typing and improved storage management.
AI in Cybersecurity - Threat actors are leveraging AI to enhance cyberattack efficiency and scale.
Women in Cybersecurity - Microsoft emphasizes the importance of diversity in cybersecurity during Women's History Month.
Malicious AI Extensions - Microsoft Defender warns of harmful browser extensions impersonating AI tools to collect sensitive data.
Copilot App Update - New feature allows Copilot to open web links in a sidepane, enhancing user experience.
Instant Access Snapshots - Azure introduces instant access for incremental snapshots, improving recovery speed and performance.
OAuth Abuse for Phishing - Microsoft identifies phishing campaigns exploiting OAuth redirection for malware delivery.
Mistral Document AI - New AI model enhances document understanding, turning unstructured data into actionable insights.
